title: Relay JSON responses
responsibility: Builds standard JSON replies and concise coded failures.

inputs.name: relayResponse.status
inputs.description: HTTP status set on the returned Response; it must be from 200 to 599 inclusive, or the Response constructor throws a RangeError. Statuses 204, 205 and 304 cannot carry a body, so they throw a TypeError when the serialized body is not undefined.

inputs.name: relayResponse.body
inputs.description: Value passed to JSON.stringify to form the response text. A BigInt or circular value makes JSON.stringify throw a TypeError, and undefined produces a response with no body.
inputs.unknownReason: The calling relay route selects the body shape and the response helper serializes it.

inputs.name: relayResponse.headers
inputs.description: Extra headers merged over the defaults Content-Type, Cache-Control and X-Content-Type-Options; a key spelled exactly like a default replaces it, while another casing is combined with the default value. An invalid header name or value makes the Response constructor throw a TypeError.

inputs.name: relayError.status
inputs.description: HTTP failure status passed straight to the Response; it must be from 200 to 599 inclusive, and 204, 205 and 304 always throw a TypeError because the error body is always present. The function does not check that the status is a failure status.

inputs.name: relayError.error
inputs.description: The code is sent as the only field of the body, so the body is an object with a single error property. The type limits it to the RelayErrorCode union, and the function does not check the value at runtime.

inputs.name: relayError.headers
inputs.description: Extra failure-response headers merged over the same defaults as relayResponse; a key spelled exactly like a default replaces it, while another casing is combined with the default value. An invalid header name or value makes the Response constructor throw a TypeError.

outputs.name: relayResponse
outputs.description: A Response whose text is the JSON of body, with the given status and the headers Content-Type: application/json, Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, each one replaced when a supplied header uses the exact same key.

outputs.name: relayError
outputs.description: A Response whose body is a JSON object with one field, error, holding the given code, with the given status and the same header rules as relayResponse.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown synchronously by the Response constructor when a status passed to relayResponse or relayError is outside 200 to 599 inclusive. Neither function catches it, so the caller receives the exception instead of a Response.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown synchronously when JSON.stringify fails on the body, when a header name or value is invalid, or when status is 204, 205 or 304 and the serialized body is present. Neither function catches it, so the caller receives the exception instead of a Response.
